episodes.executed_lambda:
(lambda (g)
 ;; The input is square and has background 0 and one nonzero PAINT color.
 ;; The MASK is the background support of that input.
 ;; At both scales, require membership in this same MASK, then paint.
 (let ()
   (define side (rows g))
   (define paint (mode g 0))
   (define (selected? value) (zero? value))
   (build-grid (* side side) (* side side) (r c)
     (if (and (selected? (at g (quotient r side) (quotient c side)))
              (selected? (at g (modulo r side) (modulo c side))))
         paint
         0))))

limitations: Task-local prototype; no production parametric API or approval is added.
Only background and foreground are supported; no second parameter is proposed.
Input grammar remains the selected generator's square, two-color grammar with background 0.
Finite setting checks identify the declared parameter, not every possible alternative rule.
Retained execution covers one seed with both settings and the canonical pairs, not all seeds.
This evidence makes no model-trajectory training-admission claim.

mask_role.meaning: select the same input-value predicate at block and subcell coordinates
mask_role.scope: one setting for the entire episode

runtime.normalizer: none for emitted self-contained lambdas; public strip_rule_wrapper for the known canonical lambda

canonical_authority.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((n (rows g))
         ;; Canonical scenes have one nonzero foreground color; mode excludes 0.
         (color (mode g 0)))
    ;; The n² x n² output is indexed by one input cell as a block anchor and
    ;; another input cell as a subcell. Paint only when BOTH source cells are 0.
    (build-grid (* n n) (* n n) (r c)
      (let ((br (/ r n)) (bc (/ c n))
            (sr (mod r n)) (sc (mod c n)))
        (if (and (zero? (at g br bc))
                 (zero? (at g sr sc)))
            color
            0))))))
